            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

                where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode

                characters of SHA-256 over the owner's normalized E.164 telephone

              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

              format: int32

              maximum: 9
              example: 4

            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-

                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's year. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'

            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner
                is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing
                same-name, same-address owner; the same value is assigned to
                every member of that household. Absent for owners that do not
                share a household.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d-372b-3f2c-9d1a-1c1f6f3b2a11'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was
                created, that shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Computed on create over the
                owners that existed before this one and returned unchanged
                thereafter.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

                creation. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present;

                owner's own fields.

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the <REGION> component of the
                owner's '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code (itself derived from the
                owner's postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.

              readOnly: true

            contactPreference:

              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

                the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to

              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true

              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented soft (possible) duplicate detection for owner creation. When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate (identity-key collision → 409) but shares an existing owner's **last name** and **postcode** with a **different telephone**, the owner is still created and flagged.

**Changes:**

It takes the lowest matching id, then sets `possibleDuplicate` (true iff a match was found) and `possibleDuplicateOf` on the owner before saving. Added a `java.util.Comparator` import.

2. **`Owner` model** — added `possibleDuplicate` (`Boolean`, `possible_duplicate`) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (`Integer`, `possible_duplicate_of`) persisted columns with getters/setters, following the existing computed-field idiom (`namesakeCount`, `bulkSignupWarning`, `householdSize`).
